errorMessage: Game terminated due to player timeout

errorDetails.reason: player-1 did not respond with an action file within the 60-second timeout period

diagnosis.expectedBehavior: Player agents should be polling for turn-signal.json and writing action files to player-actions/{player-id}.json
diagnosis.observedBehavior: No action file was created by player-1 within 60 seconds of turn signal being written
possibleCauses: Player agents were never spawned by the coordinator
Player agents crashed or stopped running
File path misconfiguration preventing agents from detecting turn signals
Player agent polling logic not working correctly
recommendations: Verify that the coordinator successfully spawned all player agents before starting the gamemaster
Check player agent logs for errors or crashes
Ensure file paths in player agent prompts match the actual directory structure
Verify player agent polling intervals and timeout logic
Consider adding health check mechanism for player agents
